Actually, with `next dev` I don't have any issue.

BUT
If the **`generateStaticParams`** function is there but returns an empty array.
(Because I didn't want my test builds to generate all pages)

```ts
export async function generateStaticParams () {
  if (env.NEXT_ENV !== 'production') return []
  
  ...
}
```
Then make a `next build` then `next start` the pages that are not pre-generated throw the `Page changed from static to dynamic at runtime` error.

However if I remove entirely the `generateStaticParams` function it works both in `dev` and in `build`.
I have the same problem but when i put `cache: "no-cache"` with fetch(), and `export const dynamic = "force-static";`

Same issue on 13.2.3 with `export const dynamicParams = true;` and a `generateStaticParams` that returns an empty array to emulate `getStaticPaths()` with `fallback:"blocking" ` in order to statically render pages on demand. We have 15000 pages with more being added every day so this is the best route for us.

FIX:
Adding `cache: 'force-cache',` to the fetch() request seems to sort it out. This however does seem to contradict the beta fetch() docs which state that `cache: 'force-cache',` is the default behaviour.

Hope someone finds this useful :)
Just tested it and it works fine with `13.2.5-canary.12`. Will add a test case to ensure.
